notes.title: Patch: New random events, organs are no longer destroyed, balance changes
Patch: Difficulty settings added, save system reworked
notes.notes:
- Difficulty settings added
- Mirrors now allow multiple saves
- Mercenaries now can pick up items and heal out of combat
- Unity engine updated: from v. 2019.4.2f1 to v. 2019.4.33f1
- Duddy moves to the H.U.B. after you encounter him for the first time
- The discount rune doesn’t increase prices anymore
- Incorrect item types fixed
- Almadhoun now sells healing items
- Organs now require 5 times less essence to craft
- Herald’s health after an organ is broken increased from 50% to 100%
- Colliders fixed
- Lutenland chests and rewards display fixed
- The strength of the vignette effect decreased to 10% 
- NPC names fixed (before engaging in dialogue)
- Multiple typos and localization errors fixed

Please, update the game via Steam.

notes.title: A statement regarding the release date
notes.notes:
Hello, heralds!

We know that all of you are eagerly anticipating the launch day. And, of course, so are we. Everyone on our team absolutely cannot wait to bring you the final product and see the reaction of our community. At the same time, shipping an unfinished game, as well as making our team members crunch, is not an option for Laughing Machines. Therefore, we made a decision to delay the release of Undungeon.

Instead of this year's second quarter, the game will come out this fall.

The development of Undungeon has been a fascinating yet extremely challenging process. Currently our team is finally approaching the finish line. We are putting all the gameplay systems together while at the same time polishing some of them, such as the combat and level up systems. Story arcs are also being finalized. 

We would like to, as always, thank you for your continuous support. However clichéd it may sound, we really, really appreciate it. There wouldn’t be Undungeon without all of you. 

THE SHIFT IS COMING!

Yours truly,

notes.title: Undungeon Arena is now available | Undungeon release date news
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36247466/915b73905e6ebb3794a4d2b6a58890648a5bb0a6.gif
Undungeon Arena is now out on Steam!

Become a powerful space gladiator and fight across multiple arenas in fantastic faraway worlds.
Undungeon Arena is a standalone single-player experience that introduces you to the complex universe of Undungeon. With a self-contained story that lets you unlock several endings, two playable characters and tons of weapons/armor pieces to obtain and enemies to battle, Arena is a glimpse of the main game that provides you with 3 to 4 hours of combat-focused gameplay. 

[previewyoutube=_O6GkhihHk4;full][/previewyoutube]

FEATURES:


 The second playable character, Marduk, is available:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36247466/8f4217723897234f616b82a127536429c9d7ae62.jpg

The Primordial Judge, the Executor, and the only god who doesn't need a Herald—which was the reason why he was imprisoned in his metal sarcophagus.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36247466/96434e31a46b7c5622f20450ed694111bd78340c.gif


 In Arena, you visit Lutenland: a harsh, dangerous world covered with swamps:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36247466/dafbe68dbac9622cca6de64f45e8f14099a2442c.jpg


Undungeon Arena is available for free. Download now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1276730/Undungeon_Arena/


-------------
We have some news to share about the release date of Undungeon

Ever since we launched our Steam page in 2019, we have been aiming for the 4th quarter of this year as our approximate release date. However now, at the end of a chaotic twelve months mess called "2020", we have to push the launch to the next year.

After overcoming a series of challenges that included relocating our office and welcoming new people into our team, we finally managed to fully put the project back on track. Regrouped and focused, we now have a vision that is solid than ever. That said, we can firmly announce that Undungeon will be released in Q2 of 2021.

We hope that you guys understand our decision. With so many delays happening this year, it's become almost comical to read about yet another game being postponed. Our intentions are nevertheless clear: obviously, we do not want to bring out an unfinished or poorly polished product. And to complete the game, we are going to need more time.

Thank you everyone who has been a part of our community for all these years, especially for our Kickstarter backers. You are awesome and we promise that we will do our absolute best to deliver.
